propositions: CodeHealthConfig.analyzers field and ANALYZERS registry are never populated or read in production code, only by test monkeypatching
resolve_analyzer, analyze_or_unavailable, and load_lizard functions have zero production call sites and should be removed

The per-language analyzer dispatch seam designed in epic 839b-f6d2-7e1a-4051 was superseded by direct composition in story c23c-c32b-982c-4196 but the removal clause was never executed because it was conditional prose rather than an acceptance criterion

The analyzer dispatch was not viable as designed: analyze_or_unavailable calls analyzer.analyze with languages=languages keyword argument but scc_loc.analyze parameter is named scan_roots, causing TypeError at runtime
Removal requires adding tombstone entries to _TOMBSTONE_REGISTRY for cfg code_health.analyzers and env REBAR_CODE_HEALTH_ANALYZERS to prevent silent config drops
AnalyzerResult and Analyzer Protocol must be retained as they are live imports in git_metrics.py and represent the working direct composition path
